title: University of Agriculture Faisalabad Amendment Act 2006

sections.shortTitle: University of Agriculture Faisalabad Amendment Act 2006
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIV OF 2006
ACT XIV OF 2006
UNIVERSITY
OF AGRICULTURE, FAISALABAD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2006
An Act further to amend the University
of Agriculture, Faisalabad Act, 1973
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, dated 2nd November, 2006]
No. PAP-Legis-2(40)/2006/877, dated 2-11-2006.---The
University of Agriculture, Faisalabad (Amendment) Bill 2006, having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 9th October, 2006, and assented to
by the Governor of the Punjab on 31st October, 2006, is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Preamble.--Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the
University
of Agriculture,
Faisalabad Act, 1973, for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act
may be cited as University of Agriculture, Faisalabad
(Amendment) Act, 2006.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

3. Amendment in section 42 of Act XII of 1973.---In the said
Act, in section 42, the full stop at the end of proviso shall be substituted by
a colon and thereafter the following proviso shall be inserted:
Provided further that if the appeal is against the
order of the Vice-Chancellor or any other officer or teacher of the University
who is a member of the Syndicate, the Vice-Chancellor, the officer or the
teacher shall not attend the proceedings of the Syndicate for decision of the
appeal and in the absence of the Vice-Chancellor, the members shall choose one
of them to chair the meeting for that item."
